key_findings: Ligustrazine reversed mechanical, cold and thermal hyperalgesia in CVeD mice
It desensitized DRG TRPA1 indirectly (not on transfected HEK293) and reduced macrophage infiltration, IL-1β and NLRP3 mRNA
